name: OIDC Login
description: Lets people sign in to the Jellyfin web UI through a single external OpenID Connect Identity Provider (tested against PocketID, so passkeys become the way into Jellyfin). Local Login keeps working.
overview: Sign in to Jellyfin through an OpenID Connect Identity Provider
